python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os,stat,re,json,urllib.request,urllib.error
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
if root.name!='create-videobot':raise SystemExit('CREATOR_REPOSITORY_NOT_SELECTED')
home=Path.home()
dirs=[root/'deploy'/'secrets',root/'deploy',home/'.config'/'create-videobot',
 root.parent/'CreateVdobot'/'deploy'/'secrets']
pattern=re.compile(r'^\d{7,15}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,100}$')
candidates={}
def check_token(token,source):
 if not pattern.fullmatch(token):return
 candidates.setdefault(token,source)
for d in dirs:
 if not d.is_dir():continue
 for f in d.iterdir():
  try:
   if f.is_symlink() or not f.is_file():continue
   st=f.stat()
   if st.st_size>8192 or st.st_size<20 or (st.st_mode & 0o022):continue
   low=f.name.lower()
   if any(x in low for x in ('session','userbot','phone','oauth','backup')):continue
   if not any(x in low for x in ('bot','token','secret','.env')):continue
   lines=f.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
   if len(lines)==1:check_token(lines[0].strip(),'private_file')
   if len(lines)<200:
    for line in lines:
     if '=' not in line or line.lstrip().startswith('#'):continue
     k,v=line.split('=',1)
     if 'TOKEN' in k.upper() and any(x in k.upper() for x in ('CREATE','VIDEO','VDO','TELEGRAM')):
      check_token(v.strip().strip('"').strip("'"),'private_env')
  except (OSError,UnicodeError):pass
print('STK04_CREDENTIAL_CANDIDATE_COUNT='+str(len(candidates)))
for value,source in candidates.items():
 try:
  req=urllib.request.Request('https://api.telegram.org/bot'+value+'/getMe',data=b'{}',
   method='POST',headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as res:obj=json.load(res)
  me=obj.get('result') if obj.get('ok') is True else None
  name=str(me.get('username','')).lower() if isinstance(me,dict) else ''
  if name!='createvdobot' or me.get('is_bot') is not True:continue
  print('STK04_CREATE_BOT_IDENTITY=VERIFIED')
  print('STK04_CREDENTIAL_SOURCE='+source)
  ident=int(me['id'])
  def api(method,data):
   req=urllib.request.Request('https://api.telegram.org/bot'+value+'/'+method,
     data=json.dumps(data).encode(),method='POST',headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
   try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as resp:return json.load(resp)
   except urllib.error.HTTPError as ex:
    return {'ok':False,'error_code':ex.code}
  r=api('getChatMember',{'chat_id':-1002373696859,'user_id':ident})
  member=r.get('result') if r.get('ok') else None
  print('STK04_CREATE_BOT_GROUP_STATUS='+str((member or {}).get('status','UNVERIFIED')))
  print('STK04_CREATE_BOT_CAN_PIN='+('YES' if (member or {}).get('can_pin_messages') is True else 'NO_OR_UNKNOWN'))
  break
 except Exception:continue
else:print('STK04_CREATE_BOT_IDENTITY=NOT_AVAILABLE')
